verdict.rationale: ChatGPT is fundamentally operated through natural-language chat: users describe tasks in plain language and ChatGPT performs actions like browsing, coding, image generation, document creation, automations, and computer use, all invoked by conversational commands (chatgpt-docs-1, chatgpt-docs-9, chatgpt-docs-10, chatgpt-docs-30, chatgpt-docs-90). Voice mode extends this to spoken natural-language commands for starting/checking tasks (chatgpt-docs-13, chatgpt-docs-51, chatgpt-docs-81). Community evidence corroborates that plain-language prompts trigger real actions like running code/containers and generating up-to-date code (chatgpt-comm-1, chatgpt-comm-13). Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification specifically of the full breadth of natural-language command coverage (e.g., automations, computer use) beyond docs and a couple of anecdotal community reports.
